entities.name: building
entities.description: A structure with a roof and walls, used as a place of shelter or for other purposes such as residential, commercial, or institutional use.

entities.name: site plan
entities.description: A detailed architectural drawing or map that shows the layout, design, and features of a specific parcel of land, including buildings, landscaping, and infrastructure.

entities.name: ordinance
entities.description: A law or regulation enacted by a city or municipal government to regulate activities within its jurisdiction.

entities.name: setbacks
entities.description: The minimum distance a building or structure must be set back from property lines, streets, or other structures as specified by zoning laws.

entities.name: neighborhood
entities.description: A geographically localized community within a city, often characterized by shared amenities, residential areas, and local identity.

entities.name: parking
entities.description: Designated areas or facilities for the temporary parking of vehicles, including regulations and management of parking spaces.

entities.name: community harmony
entities.description: The state of peaceful and cooperative relationships among members of a community, fostering social cohesion and mutual respect.
